item.title: Navan CEO Calls Amex GBT-SAP Concur Partnership ‘Antiquated’
item.description: Navan CEO Ariel Cohen dismissed the SAP Concur–Amex GBT deal as “antiquated” and "irrelevant." Has Navan truly built a more reliable, disruptive solution?

item.title: Navan Shares Plunge on Profit Miss and CFO Exit. But Wins Visa Account
item.description: Business travel platform Navan reported 29% revenue growth in its first earnings call as a public company, but the surprise departure of its CFO just months after going public has analysts seeking answers.

item.title: New Webinar: Why Travel Keeps Falling Short on Its Data Ambitions
item.description: Travel brands understand what personalization should deliver. What’s missing is integrated customer data that allows them to execute consistently across journeys and moments.

item.title: EU Sets New Climate Goals: What it Means for Airlines, Hotels, and Cruises
item.description: The mix of ambition and retreat around climate goals in the EU is sending mixed signals to an industry trying to decarbonize.

item.title: Data Centers Are Rewriting the Hotel Development Map
item.description: If you’re a hotel developer waiting for the next travel boom to tell you where to build, you’re already late. Some of the next best markets will look like “non-destinations,” but deliver durable demand from the infrastructure supercycle.

item.title: World Cup Tickets Get Cheaper for Some, but Many Travelers Will Still Pay Thousands
item.description: While loyal fans can pay as little as $60 for World Cup tickets, other travelers can expect to spend $4,000-plus for a seat at the tournament.

item.title: Spirit in Merger Talks With Frontier — Again: Report
item.description: A merger would save Spirit from shutting down, but the combined companies would still face a tough environment for ultra-low-cost carriers.

item.title: United Rewires Mobile App With AI
item.description: United rewrote its mobile boarding, disruption handling, and personalization by weaving AI throughout its app — not just layering on a chatbot. The real question is whether the automations will ultimately help smooth travel or, by introducing errors or hallucinations, add to the travel friction.

item.title: India Struggles to Attract Foreign Tourists Even as Global Travel Rebounds
item.description: India has its landscapes and diversity locked behind a meagre tourism promotion budget. No wonder its Asia-Pacific counterparts are clearly winning.

item.title: Prism IPO: We Break Down the Business Beyond Oyo
item.description: Prism will ask shareholders this weekend to approve a $744 million IPO. What it isn’t saying, yet, is the valuation it’s aiming for. After years of expansion, restructuring, and mixed financials, the unanswered question is what the company is actually worth.
